title: Nixer Red Aniseed 30ml Longfill E-Liquid
description: Red Aniseed from the NIXER Longfill concentrates collection offers a bold and distinctive aniseed flavour, delivering a rich and aromatic vaping experience. This 30ml e-liquid concentrate captures the intensely sweet and spicy taste of aniseed, making it a favourite for those who enjoy strong, unique flavours. Nixer Longfills offer a uniquely accessible approach to DIY e-liquid customisation, allowing you to create your ideal 60ml e-liquid by mixing with Nixer Mixer Kits (sold separately) Each longfill contains 30ml of 0mg e-liquid concentrate in a 60ml bottle, designed to be mixed with your choice of Nixer Mixer Kit, which includes all the necessary nic shots and VG boosters. The flavour concentrate in this longfill is suspended in PG, offering the flexibility to create either a 50% VG or 70% VG e-liquid, depending on the Mixer Kit you select. Freebase Mixer Kits will create a 70% VG blend, ideal for sub-ohm devices to produce large vapour clouds. Nic Salt Mixer Kits will create a 50% VG e-liquid, perfect for MTL (Mouth To Lung) kits, providing a more discreet vapour production. Please note: Longfill flavour concentrates are not designed to be vaped on its own – they must be mixed with a VG + Nic Shot (optional) mixer kit first. Nixer e-liquids are made in the UK by Dispergo, and are designed to be paired with Nixer Mixer Kits, allowing you to craft 60ml of vape juice with your preferred composition and strength. The mixer kits are available in freebase, Nic Salt and Menthol Nic Salt (Ice) formulations to allow for several styles of vaping and compatibility with many types of vape kit. Customisation Options: Freebase N3 Mixer Kit: 60ml of 3mg freebase e-liquid (70% VG) Freebase N6 Mixer Kit: 60ml of 6mg freebase e-liquid (70% VG) Nic Salt N5 Mixer Kit: 60ml of 5mg nic salt e-liquid (50% VG) Nic Salt N10 Mixer Kit: 60ml of 10mg nic salt e-liquid (50% VG) Nic Salt Ice N5 Mixer Kit: 60ml of 5mg ice nic salt e-liquid (50% VG) Nic Salt Ice N10 Mixer Kit: 60ml of 10mg ice nic salt e-liquid (50% VG) How to use a NIXER Mixer Kit: 1. Open your NIXER longfill eliquid concentrate bottle and pull out the nib. 2 . Pour in all 3 bottles included in your chosen NIXER Mixer Kit. 3 . Reattach the nib back on the longfill bottle and put the lid on. 4 . Shake the bottle vigorously for 1 minute. 5 . Your eliquid is ready to vape.
